snippet.title: sins of KALEIDO  Nintendo Switch™  Character Trailer: Eugene (Cast: Takuya Sato)#shorts
snippet.description:
The latest from AmuLit! Check out the Character Trailer for sins of KALEIDO, an upcoming download-exclusive game for the Nintendo Switch™ !!

✧••┈┈┈┈••✧••┈┈┈┈••✧

💜Eugene
CV. Takuya Sato

"You're confused, distorted, imperfect, and utterly human.
 So long as you remain the way you are, how could I not love you?"

📝Profile：
A sociable and understanding trader. He lives uninhibited and honest to his own desires.
That cheerfulness and a deep sense of sympathy bring both vigor and harmony to Vy-xen.

He shows no interest in the heroine's mission or her filial devotion,
only showing an unhealthy concern for her the moment she fails and falls to despair.
Sweet whispers and mischievous fingers have her at his mercy.

✧••┈┈┈┈••✧••┈┈┈┈••✧

"Hearts, sins, despair... Gather them all."

◆Nintendo eShop◆
https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/sins-of-kaleido-switch/

sins of KALEIDO: https://x.com/sinsofKALEIDO

◆Cast◆
Nobuhiko Okamoto / Kohei Amasaki / Hikaru Midorikawa / Takuya Sato / Tomoaki Maeno

◆Participating Creators◆
Director/Scenario: Ayane Ushio
Illustrator: Tana Khaki
Background Art: Shizui fen
Soundtrack: Hayato Asano
Theme Song: DUSTCELL
Development/UI: UNICO INC.

――――――――――――――

*AmuLit is Voltage Inc's new brand for console platforms.
*sins of KALEIDO is the official title for Project Code Kaleidotower, announced in 2023.
